Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome to our winter wedding — firelight, snow, and hopefully the northern lights. Thank you for braving the January cold to stand with us in Tromsø.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Elsa & Erik

❄ ❄ ❄

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2022 — A Ski Lift

We met going up a mountain

Elsa's ski slipped off the lift; Erik caught it, then caught her glove, then spent the whole ride down apologising for both. She laughed all the way to the bottom.

2023–2025 — The Winter Habit

Weekends in the snow

Every free weekend became winter — skiing, ice skating, and hot chocolate with too much cream. Erik skis fast; Elsa skis beautifully. The habit never stopped.

February 2026 — Under the Lights

He asked beneath the aurora

On a clear, cold night, as green light moved across the sky, Erik asked properly, ring warm from his pocket. Elsa said yes, then made him ask again so the lights could be in the photo.

24 January 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

Firelight, snow light, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Ice Palace Lodge, Tromsø — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

Tromsø Airport (TOS) is the nearest airport. Allow about 20 minutes by car to the lodge in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — Tromsø guesthouses & hostelsIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Central Tromsø stays; allow a short taxi to the lodge.
Mid-range — Fjord View Hotel TromsøIndicative band: mid nightly rates. A fifteen-minute taxi from the lodge, with breakfast and a fjord view.
Premium — Ice Palace Lodge (venue hotel)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — no travel in the January cold, and the northern lights from your door.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

Dress Code

Winter formal with warm layers: dark blues, silver and white, with a proper coat for the walk in. Please avoid thin shoes on ice — boots with grip, changed indoors if you like, are wisest.

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The fireside welcome is the most child-friendly part.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Parking is available at the lodge car park, cleared of snow. Arrive by 4:30 PM — the road is dark and icy after sunset, so plan your return ride in advance.

Winter formal, warm layers. Bring a proper coat and boots with grip for the icy walk; you can change shoes indoors. Avoid thin heels on ice entirely.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

January in Tromsø is cold and dark, with a few hours of blue twilight — the lodge is fully heated, but the walk from car to door is outdoors. Bring a warm coat, hat and gloves; the cloakroom is free.

❄ ❄ ❄

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly. If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.
